officialName: Festool DOMINO DF 500 Q Joining Machine (Dowel Jointer)
description: The Domino DF 500 is a handheld joining machine. Its cutter spins and swings side to side at the same time, so it cuts an oval mortise that takes a matching Domino tenon. In the makerspace it is used for frames, carcasses, mitres and panel joints in solid wood and sheet goods. Built-in stops let you place mortises from a reference edge without marking each one out. Joints cannot rotate, even with a single tenon.

specs.label: Routing depth
specs.value: presets of 12, 15, 20, 25 and 28 mm (28 mm max)

ppeRequired: protective gloves when changing cutters only
useRestrictions: Only trained users may operate it; clamp the workpiece, hold the tool with both hands, connect a dust extractor, and set the routing depth at least 3 mm less than the workpiece thickness.
